name: sacred_meadow
label: Sacred Forest Meadow
about: Pieces and textures cut from Sacred Forest Meadow (spot05). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09). `ground` is the maze and the meadow (a plain camo, no detail texture), `forest_wall` the hedge walls of the maze and the narrow ramp, `forest_trunks` and `forest_foliage` the cards of the canopy over the maze. Round the Forest Temple's courtyard: `brick` the walls, `ledge_stone` and `ledge_stone_b` the bands at the upper ledge's edge, `stone_crack` the courses above, `pillar`, `frieze`, `trim` and the `column` shades the doorway, `stone_*` the broken stairs (one stone texture under several shades); `tree_bark` the leaning dead tree, `post_side` and `post_top` the stone posts at the top of the maze.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong.

pieces.name: sfm_temple_door
pieces.label: Forest Temple doorway (exit)
pieces.about: The Forest Temple's entrance: a dark doorway 160 wide and 160 high between two stone pillars 360 tall, under a carved lintel (exit 2, ENTR_BMORI1_0). The origin is the doorway's foot on the wall's face; the exit floor starts at the face. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: sfm_temple_walkway
pieces.label: Broken stone walkway
pieces.about: The stone causeway 160 wide running from the Forest Temple's doorway out over its courtyard, 200 up, on a block (120) Link climbs onto; its front is broken off, a stub of pillar standing below it. Its back (north) end meets the wall under the doorway. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: sfm_dead_tree
pieces.label: Leaning dead tree
pieces.about: A dead trunk 340 tall leaning over the broken causeway in the Forest Temple's courtyard, a vine hanging from it. Its crown rests on the causeway: Link can walk up the trunk onto it.

pieces.name: sfm_stump
pieces.label: Saria's stump
pieces.about: The low stump (20) in front of the Forest Temple's stairs, where Saria sits to teach Saria's Song.

pieces.name: sfm_stone_post
pieces.label: Stone post
pieces.about: A square stone post 160 tall with a carved cap; a pair of them stood at the top of the maze, where the path to the temple begins.

pieces.name: sfm_ladder
pieces.label: Ladder
pieces.about: A wooden ladder 135 tall up the maze's walls (wall types ladder and ladder_top). Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: sfm_vines
pieces.label: Hanging vines
pieces.about: Vines hanging over the edge of the Forest Temple's upper ledge (cut-out cards, no collision: not climbable).
